as_told.title: Oberth's 1954 lecture on UFOs watching nuclear sites

plain: In a 1954 lecture, the German rocket pioneer Hermann Oberth is said to have spoken about UFOs, unidentified flying objects, as real craft. The physicist Kevin Knuth, who appeared on an episode titled as a NASA whistleblower interview, says he owns Oberth's notes and lecture notes. According to Knuth, in those notes Oberth says he saw "numerous radar measurements of their speeds up to 19 km per second." Knuth also mentions Wernher von Braun, a fellow rocket scientist, alongside Oberth. Michels tells the lecture differently in another episode. In his version, Oberth argued that UFOs had been seen since at least the 1400s and believed they were flown by visitors from other worlds who were watching Earth's nuclear sites and military technology. Both tellers bring it up because a founding figure of rocket science seemed to take UFOs seriously.
